Projects.p10_summary: A full-scale ERP for bakery operations — production, inventory, sales, and accounting in one platform with cross-module data integrity.
Projects.p10_desc:
A full-scale ERP system I built to run an entire bakery business on a single platform. It unifies four modules that usually live apart — **production, inventory, sales, and accounting** — while enforcing cross-module data integrity: when the kitchen completes a batch, raw-material stock is deducted automatically, finished goods land in the outlet display, and the accounting journal is posted consistently.

Built on **Laravel 12 + Inertia + React (TypeScript)**, with a real-time Kitchen Display System, granular role-based access control, and backed by **1,100+ automated tests**.

**Key Features:**
- 🥐 **Production & Kitchen** — multi-level recipes (BOM), automatic COGS calculation, real-time Kitchen Display System over websockets
- 📦 **Inventory** — per-outlet raw-material & finished-goods stock, inter-outlet transfers, periodic stock opname
- 🧾 **Sales (POS)** — cashier, member loyalty program (9,000+ registered members)
- 💰 **Finance** — automatic journaling, Chart of Accounts, balance sheet & P&L reports
- 👥 **HRIS & Payroll** — employee records, shift scheduling, payroll with allowances & overtime
- 🔐 **Security** — granular RBAC (Spatie Permission), activity audit trail
